arxiv-2107-00906.title: Using Machine Learning to Generate Test Oracles: A Systematic Literature Review Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.1145/3472675.3473974 fsews21toraclemain-id1-p ISBN: 978-1-4503-8626-5/21/08 Conference: Proceedings of the 1st International Workshop on Test Oracles; August 24, 2021; Athens, Greece Proceedings of t
arxiv-2107-00906.creator: Afonso Fontes, Gregory Gay
arxiv-2107-00906.description: Abstract . Machine learning may enable the automated generation of test oracles. We have characterized emerging research in this area through a systematic literature review examining oracle types, researcher goals, the ML techniques applied, how the generation process was assessed, and the open research challenges in this emerging field.

arxiv-2108-02899.title: Lights, Camera, Action! A Framework to Improve NLP Accuracy over OCR documents Conference: The Second Document Intelligence Workshop at KDD; 2021; Virtual Event CCS: Applied computing Document management and text processing CCS: Computing methodologies Information extraction
arxiv-2108-02899.creator: Amit Gupte, Alexey Romanov, Sahitya Mantravadi, Dalitso Banda, Jianjie Liu, Raza Khan, Lakshmanan Ramu Meenal, Benjamin Han, Soundar Srinivasan
arxiv-2108-02899.description: Abstract . Document digitization is essential for the digital transformation of our societies, yet a crucial step in the process, Optical Character Recognition (OCR), is still not perfect. Even commercial OCR systems can produce questionable output depending on the fidelity of the scanned documents.

arxiv-2306-13192.title: [THIS IS A PREPRINT] The paper will be published at IROS23 Anytime, Anywhere: Human Arm Pose from Smartwatch Data for Ubiquitous Robot Control and Teleoperation
arxiv-2306-13192.creator: Fabian C Weigend, Shubham Sonawani, Michael Drolet, Heni Ben Amor
arxiv-2306-13192.description: Abstract This work devises an optimized machine learning approach for human arm pose estimation from a single smartwatch. Our approach results in a distribution of possible wrist and elbow positions, which allows for a measure of uncertainty and the detection of multiple possible arm posture solutions, i.e., multimodal pose distributions.

arxiv-2408-09877.title: Collisional corrections to spin polarization from quantum kinetic theory using Chapman-Enskog expansion
arxiv-2408-09877.creator: Shuo Fang, Shi Pu
arxiv-2408-09877.description: Abstract We have investigated the collisional corrections to the spin polarization pseudo-vector, δ ​ 𝒫 μ \delta\mathcal{P}^{\mu} , using quantum kinetic theory in Chapman-Enskog expansion. We derive the spin Boltzmann equation incorporating Møller scattering process. We further consider two distinct scenarios using hard thermal loop approximations for simplification.

arxiv-2510-22472.title: Data-driven Exponential Framing for Pulsive Temporal Patterns without Repetition or Singularity
arxiv-2510-22472.creator: Yohei Kono, Yoshiyuki Tajima
arxiv-2510-22472.description: Abstract Extracting pulsive temporal patterns from a small dataset without their repetition or singularity shows significant importance in manufacturing applications but does not sufficiently attract scientific attention. We propose to quantify how long temporal patterns appear without relying on their repetition or singularity, enabling to extract such temporal patterns from a small dataset.

arxiv-2601-13994.title: torch-sla : Differentiable Sparse Linear Algebra with Adjoint Solvers and Sparse Tensor Parallelism for PyTorch
arxiv-2601-13994.creator: Mingyuan Chi
arxiv-2601-13994.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Mingyuan Chi. Industrial scientific computing predominantly uses sparse matrices to represent unstructured data—finite element meshes, graphs, point clouds. We present torch-sla , an open-source PyTorch library that enables GPU-accelerated, scalable, and differentiable sparse linear algebra.

arxiv-2602-23099.title: Coupling–energy driven pumping through quantum dots: the role of coherences
arxiv-2602-23099.creator: Lukas Litzba, Gernot Schaller, Jürgen König, Nikodem Szpak
arxiv-2602-23099.description: Abstract We study the impact of off–resonant tunneling and coherences on the electron pumping through quantum dots. Thereby, we focus on two electron–pump setups where lowest–order tunneling processes are suppressed and the pump is exclusively driven by modulations of the coupling energy.

pmc-10731444.title: Assessment of the response to systemic treatment of colorectal liver metastases on cross-sectional imaging – a systematic review
pmc-10731444.creator: Irmina Morawska, Andrzej Cieszanowski
pmc-10731444.description: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is one of the most common malignancies in the world. Nowadays many treatments are available to help control CRC, including surgery, radiation therapy, interventional radiology, and drug treatments. A multidisciplinary approach and the role of radiologists is needed to assist the surgeon in the management thanks to emerging technology and strategies.

pmc-11494315.title: Natural variation in age-related dopamine neuron degeneration is glutathione dependent and linked to life span
pmc-11494315.creator: Colin R. Coleman, Judit Pallos, Alicia Arreola-Bustos, Lu Wang, Daniel Raftery, Daniel E. L. Promislow, Ian Martin
pmc-11494315.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SignificanceAging is the biggest risk factor for Parkinson's disease, yet the critical factors for preserving dopamine neuron viability across age and how these connect mechanistically to PD neurodegeneration are unknown. Here, we show a striking relationship between short life span and age-related dopamine neuron loss over a large collection of natural Drosophila strains and demonstrate that glutathione deficiency arising through deficient synthesis is central to this relationship.

pmc-11672128.title: Uncovering the Dynamics of Li–Au Alloying and Li Nucleation at the Au/LiPON Interface with In Situ Z Contrast and Surface Roughness Contrast Imaging via Scanning Electron Microscopy
pmc-11672128.creator: Munekazu Motoyama, Koji Shimizu, Toshio Kimura, Takayuki Yamamoto, Satoshi Watanabe, Yasutoshi Iriyama
pmc-11672128.description: Controlling the nucleation, growth, and dissolution of Li is crucial for the high cycling stability in rechargeable Li metal batteries. The overpotential for Li nucleation (ηnc) on Li alloys such as Li–Au is generally lower than that on metal current collectors (CCs) with very limited Li solubility like Cu.

pmc-12403275.title: A comparison of the impact of nurse-led education and telehealth interventions on mental health outcomes for ambulatory patients in Saudi Arabia
pmc-12403275.creator: Ateya Megahed Ibrahim, Donia Elsaid Fathi Zaghamir, Rasha Kamal Sweelam, Heba Ahmed Osman Mohamed, Fathia Gamal Elsaid Hassabelnaby
pmc-12403275.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundMental health disorders, including depression, anxiety, and pain, are prevalent among ambulatory patients. pmc-12475858.title: Epigenetic memory: The role of the crosstalk between histone modifications and DNA methylation
pmc-12475858.creator: Domitilla Del Vecchio
pmc-12475858.description: Epigenetic memory allows different cells to maintain distinct gene expression patterns despite a common genetic code and plays a role in several biological processes. Chemical modifications to DNA and histones have appeared as critical mediators of epigenetic memory and much attention has gone into characterizing their dynamics.

pmc-12972508.title: Mapping Immune-Inflammatory Niches on Zirconia Bone Implants: Single-Cell Transcriptomic Profiling
pmc-12972508.creator: Jiannan Zhou, An Li, Jiahao Chen, Jingtao Dai, Wentai Zhang, Zhilu Yang, Ping Li
pmc-12972508.description: Zirconia (ZrO2) has become a promising alternative to titanium (Ti) for bone implants due to its excellent biocompatibility. Despite this, the osseointegration of ZrO2 remains lower than that of Ti implants. However, the underlying biological mechanisms, particularly the osteoimmune response, remain not fully elucidated.
